Tooltip_AlembicDistilling_Distill: The apparatus must be very hot and contain at least 100 ml of one supported alcoholic drink. The resulting 40% vodka remains in the apparatus. Yield depends on Cooking level; Cooking XP is awarded for the amount distilled.
Tooltip_AlembicDistilling_StationaryBuil: A stationary fire-heated distillery with a 10 litre working tank. Fuel and alcohol are loaded through separate interfaces.
IGUI_AlembicDistilling_StationaryRequire: Light the firebox, add fuel for at least 30 minutes, fill the 10 litre tank with at least 100 ml of a supported pure alcohol, and select a receiver with enough free space.
